DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_EVENT_LOG;
CREATE TABLE P2P_EVENT_LOG (
    CASE_ID VARCHAR(255),
    ACTIVITY VARCHAR(255),
    EVENT_TIME TIMESTAMP,
    USER_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    AMOUNT DECIMAL(15,2)
);

-- Create Purchase Requisition
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CAST(EBAN.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EBAN.BNFPO AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 'Create Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(EBAN.BADAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, EBAN.AFNAM AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT FROM EBAN WHERE EBAN.BADAT IS NOT NULL;

-- Create Purchase Order Item
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CAST(EKPO.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKPO.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 'Create Purchase Order Item' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(EKKO.BEDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, EKKO.ERNAM AS USER_NAME, COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0) AS AMOUNT FROM EKPO JOIN EKKO ON EKPO.EBELN = EKKO.EBELN WHERE EKPO.LOEKZ IS NULL AND EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL;

-- Change Purchase Order
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CAST(CDHDR.OBJECTID AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 'Change Purchase Order' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(CDHDR.UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT FROM CDHDR WHERE CDHDR.OBJECTCLAS = 'EINKBELEG' AND CDHDR.UDATE IS NOT NULL;

-- Record Goods Receipt
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CAST(MSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(MSEG.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 'Record Goods Receipt' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(MKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, MKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME, COALESCE(MSEG.DMBTR::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0) AS AMOUNT FROM MSEG JOIN MKPF ON MSEG.MBLNR = MKPF.MBLNR WHERE MSEG.BWART = '101' AND MKPF.BUDAT IS NOT NULL;

-- First Invoice Created
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CAST(EKBE.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKBE.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 'First Invoice Created' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(EKBE.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, COALESCE(EKBE.DMBTR::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0) AS AMOUNT FROM EKBE WHERE EKBE.VGABE = '2' AND EKBE.BUDAT IS NOT NULL;

-- Clear Invoice
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CAST(BSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BSEG.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(BSEG.AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT FROM BSEG WHERE BSEG.AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.AUGDT IS NOT NULL;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_CASES;
CREATE TABLE P2P_CASES AS
SELECT DISTINCT 
    CAST(EKPO.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKPO.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    EKPO.EBELN,
    EKPO.EBELP,
    MAX(EKKO.BEDAT)::TIMESTAMP AS PO_DATE,
    MAX(EKKO.LIFNR) AS VENDOR_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0)) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT
FROM EKPO
JOIN EKKO ON EKPO.EBELN = EKKO.EBELN
WHERE EKPO.LOEKZ IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS AP_EVENT_LOG;
CREATE TABLE AP_EVENT_LOG (
    CASE_ID VARCHAR(255),
    ACTIVITY VARCHAR(255),
    EVENT_TIME TIMESTAMP,
    USER_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    AMOUNT DECIMAL(15,2)
);

-- Create Invoice
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(BKPF.BELNR AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 
    'Create Invoice' AS ACTIVITY, 
    TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(BKPF.BUDAT), ''), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, 
    BKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME, 
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BSEG.DMBTR), '')::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0) AS AMOUNT 
FROM BKPF 
JOIN BSEG ON BKPF.BELNR = BSEG.BELNR AND BKPF.BUKRS = BSEG.BUKRS AND BKPF.GJAHR = BSEG.GJAHR
WHERE BSEG.KOART = 'K' AND NULLIF(TRIM(BKPF.BUDAT), '') IS NOT NULL;

-- Set Payment Block
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(CDHDR.OBJECTID AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 
    'Set Payment Block' AS ACTIVITY, 
    TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(CDHDR.UDATE), ''), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, 
    CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 
    0.0 AS AMOUNT 
FROM CDHDR 
JOIN CDPOS ON CDHDR.CHANGENR = CDPOS.CHANGENR
JOIN BKPF ON CDHDR.OBJECTID = BKPF.BELNR
WHERE CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' AND NULLIF(TRIM(CDPOS.VALUE_NEW), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(CDHDR.UDATE), '') IS NOT NULL;

-- Release Payment Block
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(CDHDR.OBJECTID AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 
    'Release Payment Block' AS ACTIVITY, 
    TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(CDHDR.UDATE), ''), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, 
    CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 
    0.0 AS AMOUNT 
FROM CDHDR 
JOIN CDPOS ON CDHDR.CHANGENR = CDPOS.CHANGENR
JOIN BKPF ON CDHDR.OBJECTID = BKPF.BELNR
WHERE CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' AND NULLIF(TRIM(CDPOS.VALUE_NEW), '') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(CDHDR.UDATE), '') IS NOT NULL;

-- Clear Invoice
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(BSEG.BELNR AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BSEG.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BSEG.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID, 
    'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY, 
    TO_TIMESTAMP(NULLIF(TRIM(BSEG.AUGDT), ''), 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, 
    NULL AS USER_NAME, 
    0.0 AS AMOUNT 
FROM BSEG 
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(BSEG.AUGBL), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(BSEG.AUGDT), '') IS NOT NULL;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS AP_CASES;
CREATE TABLE AP_CASES AS
SELECT DISTINCT 
    CAST(BKPF.BELNR AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    BKPF.BELNR,
    BKPF.BUKRS,
    BKPF.GJAHR,
    MAX(BKPF.BUDAT)::TIMESTAMP AS POSTING_DATE,
    MAX(BSEG.LIFNR) AS VENDOR_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(BSEG.DMBTR), '')::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0)) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT,
    MAX(BKPF.WAERS) AS CURRENCY
FROM BKPF
JOIN BSEG ON BKPF.BELNR = BSEG.BELNR AND BKPF.BUKRS = BSEG.BUKRS AND BKPF.GJAHR = BSEG.GJAHR
WHERE BSEG.KOART = 'K'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

I replaced these with `NULLIF(TRIM(col), '') IS NOT NULL` to safely filter out empty or whitespace-only strings. I also ensured all numeric casts use the `COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(col), '')::DECIMAL(15,2), 0.0)` pattern to prevent runtime errors on empty or invalid numeric fields.

    'Create Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(EBAN.BADAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    COALESCE(EBAN.MENGE, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
FROM EBAN
WHERE EBAN.BADAT IS NOT NULL;

-- Create Purchase Order Item
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(EKPO.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKPO.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Create Purchase Order Item' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(EKKO.BEDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    EKKO.ERNAM AS USER_NAME,
    COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
FROM EKPO
JOIN EKKO ON EKPO.EBELN = EKKO.EBELN
WHERE EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL;

-- Record Goods Receipt
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(MSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(MSEG.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Record Goods Receipt' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(MKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    MKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME,
    COALESCE(MSEG.MENGE, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
FROM MSEG
JOIN MKPF ON MSEG.MBLNR = MKPF.MBLNR AND MSEG.MJAHR = MKPF.MJAHR
WHERE MSEG.BWART = '101' AND MSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL AND MSEG.EBELP IS NOT NULL;

-- First Invoice Created (Aggregated to avoid duplicates)
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CASE_ID,
    'First Invoice Created' AS ACTIVITY,
    MIN(EVENT_TIME) AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CAST(EKBE.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKBE.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
        TO_TIMESTAMP(EKBE.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
        COALESCE(EKBE.WRBTR, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
    FROM EKBE
    WHERE EKBE.VGABE = '2' AND EKBE.BUDAT IS NOT NULL
) AS SUB
GROUP BY 1;

-- Clear Invoice (Aggregated to avoid duplicates)
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CASE_ID,
    'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY,
    MIN(EVENT_TIME) AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CAST(BSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BSEG.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
        TO_TIMESTAMP(BSEG.AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
        COALESCE(BSEG.DMBTR, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
    FROM BSEG
    WHERE BSEG.AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.EBELP IS NOT NULL
) AS SUB
GROUP BY 1;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_CASES;
CREATE TABLE P2P_CASES AS
SELECT 
    CAST(EKPO.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKPO.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    EKPO.EBELN,
    EKPO.EBELP,
    MAX(EKKO.LIFNR) AS VENDOR_ID,
    MAX(EKPO.MATNR) AS MATNR,
    SUM(COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR, 0.0)) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT,
    MIN(EKKO.BEDAT) AS PO_DATE
FROM EKPO
JOIN EKKO ON EKPO.EBELN = EKKO.EBELN
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3;

    'Create Purchase Order Item' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(EKKO.BEDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,

WHERE EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL;

-- Record Goods Receipt

    CAST(MSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(MSEG.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,

    TO_TIMESTAMP(BSEG.AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    COALESCE(BSEG.DMBTR, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
FROM BSEG
WHERE BSEG.AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.AUGDT IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.EBELP IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG

    CAST(EKPO.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(EKPO.EBELP AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Payment Block' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(CDHDR.UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME,
    0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR
JOIN CDPOS ON CDHDR.CHANGENR = CDPOS.CHANGENR
JOIN EKPO ON CDHDR.OBJECTID = EKPO.EBELN
WHERE CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' AND CDHDR.UDATE IS NOT NULL;

    MAX(EKKO.LIFNR) AS VENDOR_ID,

WHERE EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL AND EKPO.LOEKZ IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3, 4;

-- Record Goods Receipt
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(MSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Record Goods Receipt' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(MKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    MKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(MSEG.MENGE, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM MSEG
JOIN MKPF ON MSEG.MBLNR = MKPF.MBLNR AND MSEG.MJAHR = MKPF.MJAHR
WHERE MSEG.BWART = '101' AND MSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3, 4;

-- First Invoice Created
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CASE_ID,
    'First Invoice Created' AS ACTIVITY,
    MIN(EVENT_TIME) AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CAST(EKBE.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
        TO_TIMESTAMP(EKBE.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
        COALESCE(EKBE.WRBTR, 0.0) AS AMOUNT
    FROM EKBE
    WHERE EKBE.VGABE = '2' AND EKBE.BUDAT IS NOT NULL
) AS SUB
GROUP BY 1;

-- Clear Invoice
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(BSEG.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(BSEG.AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(BSEG.DMBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM BSEG
WHERE BSEG.AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.AUGDT IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_CASES;
CREATE TABLE P2P_CASES AS
SELECT 
    CAST(EKKO.EBELN AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    EKKO.EBELN,
    MAX(EKKO.LIFNR) AS VENDOR_ID,
    MAX(EKKO.EKORG) AS PURCHASING_ORG,
    MIN(EKKO.BEDAT) AS PO_DATE,
    SUM(COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR, 0.0)) AS TOTAL_PO_VALUE
FROM EKKO
JOIN EKPO ON EKKO.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN
WHERE EKPO.LOEKZ IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2;

CREATE TABLE AP_EVENT_LOG (

    EVENT_TIME TIMESTAMP,
    USER_NAME VARCHAR(255),

);

-- Invoice Received (Entry)
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(BKPF.BELNR AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Invoice Received' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(BKPF.CPUDT || ' ' || LEFT(BKPF.CPUTM, 8), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS EVENT_TIME,
    BKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME,
    0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM BKPF
WHERE BKPF.STBLG IS NULL AND BKPF.CPUDT IS NOT NULL AND BKPF.CPUDT <> '';

-- Create Invoice
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(BKPF.BELNR AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Create Invoice' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(BKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    BKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(BSEG.DMBTR) AS AMOUNT
FROM BKPF

-- Create Invoice
INSERT INTO AP_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    CAST(BKPF.BELNR AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,

    TO_TIMESTAMP(BKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,

    SUM(COALESCE(BSEG.DMBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM BKPF
JOIN BSEG ON BKPF.BELNR = BSEG.BELNR AND BKPF.BUKRS = BSEG.BUKRS AND BKPF.GJAHR = BSEG.GJAHR

    CAST(CDHDR.OBJECTID AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.BUKRS AS VARCHAR(255)) || '-' || CAST(BKPF.GJAHR AS VARCHAR(255)) AS CASE_ID,
    'Set Payment Block' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(CDHDR.UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME,
    0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR
JOIN CDPOS ON CDHDR.CHANGENR = CDPOS.CHANGENR
JOIN BKPF ON CDHDR.OBJECTID = BKPF.BELNR AND CDHDR.OBJECTCLAS = 'BELEG'
WHERE CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' AND CDPOS.VALUE_NEW <> '' AND CDHDR.UDATE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CDHDR.UDATE) <> '';

-- Clear Invoice

    'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(BSEG.AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,

    SUM(COALESCE(BSEG.DMBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM BSEG
WHERE BSEG.AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND BSEG.AUGDT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BSEG.AUGDT) <> '' AND BSEG.KOART = 'K'
GROUP BY 1, 3, 4;

CREATE TABLE P2P_EVENT_LOG (

);

-- Create Purchase Requisition
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    EBELN AS CASE_ID,
    'Create Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(BADAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    NULL AS USER_NAME,
    0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM EBAN
WHERE BADAT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BADAT) <> '';

-- Create Purchase Order Item
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    EKKO.EBELN AS CASE_ID,
    'Create Purchase Order Item' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(EKKO.BEDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    EKKO.ERNAM AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM EKKO
JOIN EKPO ON EKKO.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN
WHERE EKKO.LOEKZ IS NULL AND EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(EKKO.BEDAT) <> ''
GROUP BY 1, 3, 4;

-- Record Goods Receipt
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT 
    MSEG.EBELN AS CASE_ID,
    'Record Goods Receipt' AS ACTIVITY,
    TO_TIMESTAMP(MKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME,
    MKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(MSEG.MENGE, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM MSEG
JOIN MKPF ON MSEG.MBLNR = MKPF.MBLNR AND MSEG.MJAHR = MKPF.MJAHR
WHERE MSEG.BWART = '101' AND MSEG.SHKZG <> 'H' AND MSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL AND MKPF.BUDAT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3, 4;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_EVENT_LOG;
CREATE TABLE P2P_EVENT_LOG (
    CASE_ID VARCHAR(255),
    ACTIVITY VARCHAR(255),
    EVENT_TIME TIMESTAMP,
    USER_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    AMOUNT DECIMAL(15,2)
);

-- Create Purchase Requisition
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Create Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(BADAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM EBAN WHERE EBELN IS NOT NULL AND BADAT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BADAT) <> '';

-- Create Purchase Order Item
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EKKO.EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Create Purchase Order Item' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(EKKO.BEDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, EKKO.ERNAM AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM EKKO JOIN EKPO ON EKKO.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN WHERE EKKO.LOEKZ IS NULL AND EKPO.LOEKZ IS NULL AND EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EKKO.EBELN, EKKO.BEDAT, EKKO.ERNAM;

-- Record Goods Receipt
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT MSEG.EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Record Goods Receipt' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(MKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, MKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(MSEG.MENGE, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM MSEG JOIN MKPF ON MSEG.MBLNR = MKPF.MBLNR AND MSEG.MJAHR = MKPF.MJAHR WHERE MSEG.BWART = '101' AND MSEG.SHKZG <> 'H' AND MSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MSEG.EBELN, MKPF.BUDAT, MKPF.USNAM;

-- First Invoice Created
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'First Invoice Created' AS ACTIVITY, MIN(TO_TIMESTAMP(BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(WRBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM EKBE WHERE VGABE = '2' AND EBELN IS NOT NULL AND BUDAT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EBELN;

-- Clear Invoice
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(DMBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM BSEG WHERE AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND AUGDT IS NOT NULL AND EBELN IS NOT NULL AND EBELN <> '' GROUP BY EBELN, AUGDT;

-- Change Purchase Order (Generic)
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT OBJECTID AS CASE_ID, 'Change Purchase Order' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR WHERE OBJECTCLAS = 'EINKBELEG' AND UDATE IS NOT NULL;

-- Change Purchase Requisition
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT OBJECTID AS CASE_ID, 'Change Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR WHERE OBJECTCLAS = 'BANF' AND UDATE IS NOT NULL;

-- Payment Block
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CDHDR.OBJECTID AS CASE_ID, 'Payment Block' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(CDHDR.UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR JOIN CDPOS ON CDHDR.CHANGENR = CDPOS.CHANGENR WHERE CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' AND CDPOS.VALUE_NEW <> '';

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_CASES;
CREATE TABLE P2P_CASES AS
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, EBELN, MAX(BUKRS) AS BUKRS, MAX(LIFNR) AS LIFNR, MIN(BEDAT) AS PO_DATE, MAX(BSART) AS BSART, MAX(EKORG) AS EKORG
FROM EKKO WHERE LOEKZ IS NULL GROUP BY EBELN;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_EVENT_LOG;
CREATE TABLE P2P_EVENT_LOG (
    CASE_ID VARCHAR(255),
    ACTIVITY VARCHAR(255),
    EVENT_TIME TIMESTAMP,
    USER_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    AMOUNT DECIMAL(15,2)
);

-- Create Purchase Requisition
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Create Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(BADAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM EBAN WHERE EBELN IS NOT NULL AND BADAT IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BADAT) <> '';

-- Create Purchase Order Item
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EKKO.EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Create Purchase Order Item' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(EKKO.BEDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, EKKO.ERNAM AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(EKPO.NETWR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM EKKO JOIN EKPO ON EKKO.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN WHERE EKKO.LOEKZ IS NULL AND EKPO.LOEKZ IS NULL AND EKKO.BEDAT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EKKO.EBELN, EKKO.BEDAT, EKKO.ERNAM;

-- Record Goods Receipt
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT MSEG.EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Record Goods Receipt' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(MKPF.BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, MKPF.USNAM AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(MSEG.MENGE, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM MSEG JOIN MKPF ON MSEG.MBLNR = MKPF.MBLNR AND MSEG.MJAHR = MKPF.MJAHR WHERE MSEG.BWART = '101' AND MSEG.SHKZG <> 'H' AND MSEG.EBELN IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MSEG.EBELN, MKPF.BUDAT, MKPF.USNAM;

-- First Invoice Created
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'First Invoice Created' AS ACTIVITY, MIN(TO_TIMESTAMP(BUDAT, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(WRBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM EKBE WHERE VGABE = '2' AND EBELN IS NOT NULL AND BUDAT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EBELN;

-- Clear Invoice
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, 'Clear Invoice' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(AUGDT, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, NULL AS USER_NAME, SUM(COALESCE(DMBTR, 0.0)) AS AMOUNT
FROM BSEG WHERE AUGBL IS NOT NULL AND AUGDT IS NOT NULL AND EBELN IS NOT NULL AND EBELN <> '' GROUP BY EBELN, AUGDT;

-- Change Purchase Order (Generic)
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT OBJECTID AS CASE_ID, 'Change Purchase Order' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR WHERE OBJECTCLAS = 'EINKBELEG' AND UDATE IS NOT NULL;

-- Change Purchase Requisition
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT OBJECTID AS CASE_ID, 'Change Purchase Requisition' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR WHERE OBJECTCLAS = 'BANF' AND UDATE IS NOT NULL;

-- Payment Block
INSERT INTO P2P_EVENT_LOG
SELECT CDHDR.OBJECTID AS CASE_ID, 'Payment Block' AS ACTIVITY, TO_TIMESTAMP(CDHDR.UDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS EVENT_TIME, CDHDR.USERNAME AS USER_NAME, 0.0 AS AMOUNT
FROM CDHDR JOIN CDPOS ON CDHDR.CHANGENR = CDPOS.CHANGENR WHERE CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' AND CDPOS.VALUE_NEW <> '';

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS P2P_CASES;
CREATE TABLE P2P_CASES AS
SELECT EBELN AS CASE_ID, EBELN, MAX(BUKRS) AS BUKRS, MAX(LIFNR) AS LIFNR, MIN(BEDAT) AS PO_DATE, MAX(BSART) AS BSART, MAX(EKORG) AS EKORG
FROM EKKO WHERE LOEKZ IS NULL GROUP BY EBELN;
